answer: Audits are entered in signal, queued in spiral, and prism publishes the wait time. A farm of 360 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 20 identities per epoch. A farm of 4775 identities would post 2134 proofs and burn roughly 88 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
